desc_id: Magelang dijuluki Kota Getuk. Getuk dibuat dari singkong yang dikukus, ditumbuk halus, lalu diberi gula.
desc_en: Magelang is nicknamed the Getuk Town. Getuk is made from cassava that is steamed, pounded smooth and then sweetened.
